title: The Genesis of Kustomazi
synopsis: Before Planet Kustomazi was created, there was a quiet void—formless, without shape, teeming with potential, unmoved and aimless, carrying the stories to start worlds. Suddenly, a cosmic spark ignited, and shining through the light was Kasutamaiza, the Customizer, accompanied by his devout servants. Shaping the void into a celestial seed, Kasutamaiza sprang forth Planet Kustomazi into existence. Duel through the primordial stillness, witness the first spark, test your resolve against the faithful heralds, and behold the miraculous creation of Planet Kustomazi!

stages.title: The Quiet Void
stages.intro_dialogue: Before Planet Kustomazi was created, there was a quiet void. Formless, without shape, teeming with potential, this cosmic abyss was unmoved and aimless, carrying the stories to start worlds. As you step into the darkness, a formless current stirs—an Echo of the Quiet Void awakens to test if your spirit can maintain form in the stillness!
stages.outro_dialogue: The quiet void hums in tranquil harmony. Its unshaped currents yield to your resolve. But the cosmic silence begins to tremble—a sudden warmth stirs in the deep!

stages.title: The Sudden Spark
stages.intro_dialogue: Suddenly, through the infinite stillness of the quiet void, a radiant spark ignites! Brilliant cosmic light pulses through the darkness, scattering the slumbering shadows. The primordial energy surges with nascent warmth—a Spark of the Primordial manifests, challenging you to test if your deck can withstand the awakening fires of creation!
stages.outro_dialogue: The radiant embers swirl gently around your cards. You have embraced the primordial spark without being consumed. Through the blinding light, a magnificent celestial presence begins to descend...

stages.title: Heralds of the Customizer
stages.intro_dialogue: Shining through the celestial light comes Kasutamaiza, the Customizer! He does not arrive alone—with him come his devout servants, faithful workers and heralds to the sacred work Kasutamaiza is about to begin. The heralds step forward, their eyes ablaze with divine purpose: 'Before the Master shapes the world, we must test if your bond with your cards is worthy of witnessing genesis!'
stages.outro_dialogue: The devout heralds bow in deep solemn reverence. 'Your spirit rings true, duelist. The Master prepares to forge the celestial seed. Step forward and behold the birth of a world!'

stages.title: The Shaping of Planet Kustomazi
stages.intro_dialogue: "Welcome, duelist," a voice of supreme cosmic warmth resounds. Kasutamaiza, the Customizer, gathers the unshaped void into his hands, concentrating its infinite potential into a luminous celestial seed. "You have braved the quiet void, withstood the primordial spark, and proven your spirit to my faithful servants. Now, watch as I spring forth the planet—Planet Kustomazi! Let our cards weave the foundation of a brand new world!"
stages.outro_dialogue: "Magnificent!" Kasutamaiza smiles with profound joy as the crust of Planet Kustomazi solidifies beneath your feet, radiating with oceans, continents, and skies of golden aurora. "Planet Kustomazi is born! Our world has taken form, and you are its first honored champion. Rest now, duelist—for as our world continues to shape, new orders shall rise upon its soil, and distant rifts shall awaken!"

1.play: Kasutamaiza gathers unshaped void potential into a celestial seed! Activates **The Seed of Creation** (`TLOK-003`), Special Summoning **The Void of Creation** (`TLOK-002`) in Defense Position!
1.quote: "From unshaped silence, the seed of our world is forged..."

2.play: Kasutamaiza channels the primordial void, Special Summoning **Formless the True Void of Creation** (`TLOK-005`)! A wave of unshaped energy ripples across the duel field!
2.quote: "Can your spirit maintain form against unshaped infinity?"

pivots.play: Observing your summoned monsters, Kasutamaiza activates **The Spark of Creation** (`TLOK-012`), banishing void essence from the GY to unleash a concentrated cosmic beam!
pivots.quote: "A spark to test your resolve! Form cannot falter before creation!"

pivots.play: Kasutamaiza extends his hand with measured restraint, summoning **Servants of the Great Kasutamaiza** (`TLOK-004`) to prepare the celestial altar!
pivots.quote: "Stand firm! We are weaving the very foundation of existence!"

3.play: The celestial seed bursts open in brilliant golden light! Kasutamaiza activates the Field Spell **Planet Kustomazi** (`TLOK-010`)! The new world springs forth into existence across the duel mat!

pivots.play: With the field open to the heavens, Kasutamaiza invokes **Planet Kustomazi** (`TLOK-010`) and Normal Summons **Kasutamaiza, the Creator of Kustomazi** (`TLOK-001`) with 4000 ATK!
pivots.quote: "Witness the dawn of Planet Kustomazi in all its majesty!"

repeat.play: Planet Kustomazi radiates vibrant cosmic creation energy across the field!
repeat.quote: "The chronicle of our world has just begun!"

script_data.threshold_4000: 🌌 *Kasutamaiza's eyes radiate profound divine warmth! "Magnificent! Your spirit has harmonized with the birth of our world! Planet Kustomazi is whole!"*
